items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Barefield did a lot of those dates too.

ctx.x: Yes, he followed Buster Bailey, uh-huh. Uh-huh. And I'm trying to think who else did we have. Well, Bushell not this -- uh, Eddie Barefield did a lot of those dates too. Know Eddie Barefield, clarinet player?
: Yeah, I know him, very fine.

items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: in 1969 I took a trip with Red Richards, Saints and Sinners, back to Europe again, and we had Buddy Tate and Herman Autrey.

ctx.x: What I meant by documentary, you know, they made movies of the whole trip, and I think Dick Vance has some of the movies. They were not available to everybody, but he has them.
And after coming back from Africa I -- that next year I took a trip, in 1969 I took a trip with Red Richards, Saints and Sinners, back to Europe again, and we had Buddy Tate and Herman Autrey.
Yeah, I remember reading about that.
